compliance.emc: FCC 47 CFR Part 15 Class A, EN 55022 Class A, ICES-003, VCCI Class A
compliance.nebs: NEBS certified (datasheet Table 1 and compliance section)

environmental.acoustic-noise: 50.8 dBA with the 320 W AC supply (datasheet, ISO 7779 at 23 C)
environmental.altitude: up to 3049 m operating (10,000 ft); 4877 m non-operating
environmental.humidity: 10 to 85 percent noncondensing operating; 0 to 95 percent non-operating

features.optics-sfp: 100BASE-FX (EX-SFP-1FE-FX, -LX, -BX), 1000BASE-X (SX, LX, LH, BX, CWDM) and 1000BASE-T copper SFP (EX-SFP-1GE-T) (datasheet ordering information)
features.uplink-module: one slot; EX-UM-4SFP, EX-UM-2X4SFP, EX-UM-2X4SFP-M or EX-UM-2XFP (not part of the shipping configuration)
features.virtual-chassis: up to 10 members over the 128 Gbps backplane; two rear Virtual Chassis ports, and the SFP network ports can be configured as VCPs

management.lcd: 2 lines of 16 characters with Menu and Enter buttons
management.oob: RJ-45 management port on the rear, 100 Mbps full duplex, with link/activity and status lamps
management.usb: one USB port on the rear

performance.switching-capacity: 88 Gbps packet switching, 216 Gbps aggregate, 64-byte packets (datasheet)

physical.datasheet-dimensions: 17.41 x 1.72 x 16.43 in (44.21 x 4.32 x 41.73 cm) W x H x D; the guide's Table 3 is used for the envelope
physical.depth-with-large-psu: 489 mm (19.25 in, 48.9 cm) with a 600 W or 930 W AC supply (guide Table 3); 18.8 in (47.8 cm) in the datasheet
physical.weight: 16.1 lb (7.3 kg) with the 320 W AC supply (datasheet); 16-18 lb (7.2-8.2 kg) with one supply (guide Table 3)
physical.weight-chassis-parts: 320 W AC and 190 W DC supplies 2.5 lb (1.1 kg); 600 W and 930 W AC supplies 3.1 lb (1.4 kg) (guide Table 3)
physical.width-with-brackets: 482 mm (19 in, 48.2 cm) with the mounting brackets attached

power.psu-redundancy: one supply carries a fully loaded chassis; a second gives redundancy (datasheet)

configs.description: EX4200-24F as shipped - one 320 W AC power supply in slot 0 with a cover panel over slot 1, the fan tray, and the uplink slot covered, with 24 dust covers for the SFP ports in the box. Side-to-rear airflow. The datasheet also orders the Trade Agreements Act build EX4200-24F-TAA, the same hardware.
configs.name: ac

configs.description: EX4200-24F-DC - one 190 W DC power supply in slot 0 and the fan tray: DC powered.
configs.name: dc

configs.description: EX4200-24F-S - the spare chassis, shipped with no power supply and no fan tray: "Power supplies for this model are not shipped by default; you must order them separately", and so is the fan tray. The supply and fan bays are shown open.
configs.name: s

gaps.wanted: A straight-on photograph of the rear. The maker's image library returned 404 for every EX4200 address tried, so the rear is read off the low-resolution callout figure and the supply and fan art follows the isometric drawings.

A straight-on studio photograph of the front. The datasheet's photographs are perspective views from above, so the vertical positions carry a 4 percent foreshortening and every front position is estimated.
Which of the two lamps above each SFP cage is Link/Activity and which Status; no document held says.
What the -DC build prints on its model plate; the guide shows the same front for it and the datasheet photograph is of the AC build.
Where the two-hole protective earthing terminal sits on the side panel and its hole pitch.
The bracket positions of the front, centre and rear mounting and of the 2-in-recess brackets: no figure in the guide measures them, so no ear position or kit is listed.
A library component for an LCD display; the LCD panel is a decor rectangle until one exists.
The four EX-UM uplink modules and their ports, left for a later uplink-module slice; the bay takes only the cover panel here.
The fan tray's power draw: neither the guide nor the datasheet states it.

a `power-draw-max-w` on each module this chassis accepts, from the vendor's own per-card table - Cisco publishes one per ambient, most vendors publish none, and until they land a module total is a floor
one of `power-max-w`, `power-max-ac-w`, `power-max-dc-w` in `attrs.power` (profile `networking` - see spec/schemas/profiles.yaml) - unlocks the About panel, and comparison against other devices
`physical-context` on 4 bays (front 1, rear 3); `physical-context` on port group sfp - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays

airflow.note: Guide, Airflow Direction in the EX4200 Switch Chassis and Figure 16: the fan tray "provides side-to-rear chassis cooling"; the datasheet gives 20.3 cfm. The chassis airflow enumeration has no side-to-rear, so `side` is written, the nearest answer; there is no back-to-front build.

chassis.note: Guide Table 3: height 1.75 in (4.45 cm) = 44.45 mm; width 17.25 in (43.82 cm) = 438.2 mm, "19 in. (48.2 cm) with mounting brackets attached", so 438.2 is the body between the bracket flanges; depth 17 in (43.18 cm) with no supply, with the 320 W AC supply or with the 190 W DC supply, and 19.25 in (48.9 cm) with a 600 W or 930 W AC supply (they extend 2.25 in). This model ships with the 320 W supply, so the modelled depth is 431.8 mm. THE DATASHEET DISAGREES: it gives 17.41 x 1.72 x 16.43 in (44.21 x 4.32 x 41.73 cm) and 18.8 in (47.8 cm) with the 600 W or 930 W supply. The hardware guide is the newer and the more specific document, so the guide's figures are used; the datasheet's are in attrs. 1RU.

colour.note: The datasheet photograph shows a black face with a navy top strip: the strip reads #191f32 (median of 800 px) and the lower plate #504e57 where a highlight crosses it. The face is drawn #2b2f3d, between the two. Supply and fan faces are estimated; no photograph of the rear is held.

ears.note: NOT MODELLED. The packing list ships two mounting brackets and eight screws; the guide mounts the switch on two posts with those, on four posts with the separately orderable four-post rack-mount kit (datasheet EX-4PST-RMK), recessed 2 in from the front with that kit's 2-in-recess brackets, on a desk on rubber feet, or on a wall with the wall-mount kit (EX-WMK); the datasheet also lists EX-RMK. No figure dimensions the bracket positions, so no ear position is written and no rail kit is listed in chassis.kits.

front-ports.note: 24 SFP cages in one row, four blocks of six. Read off the 24F datasheet photograph at 2.05 px per mm with the face's left edge at 0: the first cage is centred at 14.0 mm and the last at 349.4 mm, a cage pitch of 14.2, the registry's 14.25 for ganged SFP cages (they abut); the groups of six start 88.1 mm apart, so the gutter is 88.1 - 6 x 14.25 = 2.6 mm. The block is placed at 6.88 mm, a cage centre of 14.005, so that every cage edge lands on a hundredth of a millimetre and no two openings overlap. Cage centres read 34.0 mm down, so the registry's 10.4 mm cage sits with its top at 28.8 mm. The blocks start at the same 88 mm spacing as the copper models' jack blocks. The cages carry the registry's `std/sfp-ganged` art.

front-right.note: Read off the 24F photograph at 2.05 px per mm across and up from the bottom edge, and checked against the 48-port photographs (the LCD centre at 15.2 and 15.05 mm): the raised right-hand module panel 362.5 to 438.2 mm; the LCD window 375.5 to 411.2 x 10.3 to 19.9 mm; the Menu button centre (420.7, 12.5) and the Enter button (420.7, 20.7), 6.1 mm across; the three chassis lamps at x 427.8, y 9.05, 12.85 and 16.75; a face screw each side at (366.5, 22.0) and (429.9, 22.0); the uplink slot 366.9 to 429.9 x 26.5 to 41.0 mm; the model plate 296.5 to 344.0 x 0.9 to 5.0 mm with "EX4200" centred at 304.5 and "24SFP" at 334.3. The Juniper logo at the left of the top strip, 6.4 to 22.2 x 1.0 to 5.1 mm, is reserved as a logo zone and not drawn.

fru-bays.note: Two power supply bays and one fan tray bay. The cover panel the guide ships for an empty supply slot is seated in slot 1 as shipped and the supply in slot 0. Mixing AC and DC supplies is not supported (the guide); a bay lists every part it can take and a configuration seats a matching set. Nothing is built into the chassis.

gate-1-front.note: The datasheet photograph of the 24F (page 6, top) is a perspective view from above: its face spans 900 px across for the guide's 438.2 mm (2.05 px per mm) and is 4 percent shorter than orthographic down. Columns are read at the across scale and heights at the face's own scale counted up from the bottom edge. The 48-port photographs (2.04 and 2.07 px per mm) read the right-hand block within 1.5 mm, which is the second image the figures are checked against. The guide's own figure of the front (Figure 3, g020067) is 565 px wide in the PDF and gives counts and order only.

gate-1-rear.note: Guide Figure 4 (g020084, 609 x 252 px as embedded), shared by all the EX4200 models: the chassis outline is 557 px across for 438.2 mm (1.271 px per mm) and its face is 5 percent foreshortened vertically. Positions across are read at 1.271 px per mm and heights at 0.828 mm per px from the top edge of the face. It is a low resolution raster, so every rear position is good to about 2 mm.

interface-names.note: Not printed and not modelled. The guide's examples name the network ports ge-0/0/0 and up, the uplink module's ports ge-0/1/0 and up and the Virtual Chassis ports vcp-0 and vcp-1; they stay here and not in an interfaces block.

lamp-legends.note: drawing-vs-photo: guide Figures 5 and 9 print ALM, SYS and MST to the right of the three lamps. The photograph resolves a dark bar there and cannot resolve type 1.4 mm high at 2.05 px per mm (the 2.2 mm numerals resolve), so it neither confirms nor contradicts the drawing. The legends are drawn as the guide draws them, in the guide's order of naming.

lcd.note: The LCD panel shows two lines of 16 characters. It is drawn as the green window the photograph shows; no library component exists for a display, so it is a decor rectangle and not a part.

lifecycle.note: Searched on 2026-10-23. Juniper's own milestones page was not reachable; third-party trackers (eol.network, parkplacetechnologies.com, relutech.com, serviceexpress.com) give an end-of-life announcement of 2019-02-01 for the EX4200 family, last order 2019-06-30 and last day of support 2024-06-30. The dates are written, from a tracker and not from the maker.

other-faces.note: No source draws the top, bottom or sides flat. Each carries an `empty` sentence.

poe-numerals.note: The model plate at the right of the top strip reads "EX4200" in white and "24SFP" in orange on the datasheet photograph; the fibre model has no PoE, so its numerals are white.

port-lamps.note: Guide, Network Port LEDs in EX4200 Switches, Tables 7 and 8: each network port has two lamps, a Link/Activity lamp (green) and a Status lamp. On this model the photograph shows two small dark lamps above each cage, below its numeral, centred 1.9 mm left and 4.0 mm right of the cage centre and 25.75 mm down. Which is which is not stated by any document held; the left is taken as Link/Activity, the order the guide names them, and is estimated. The left lamp is drawn 2.2 mm left of the cage centre, where the photograph reads 1.9, because a lamp within 2 mm of its cage's centre reads to lint as a slip at centring.

port-numbering.note: The photograph prints one numeral above each cage, 0 to 23 left to right, centred over the cage; the numerals are 2.2 mm high and drawn at 2.2 mm type (estimated). They are white: the fibre model has no PoE ports. The guide's CLI names (ge-0/0/0 to ge-0/0/23) are not printed on the metal and are not modelled.

power.note: The 320 W supply is the minimum (Table 1); the AC current rating is 4 A for the switch with 24 SFP ports (Table 12). The guide and the datasheet give no typical or maximum draw of the switch itself.

psu-seating.note: Guide, Power Supply in EX4200 Switches and Table 1 (the supply is "Power Supply (Minimum)"): the 320 W AC supply is the minimum for this model and the 190 W DC supply is the one its -DC build ships with; "All EX4200 switches support EX-PWR2-930-AC and EX-PWR3-930-AC". The guide does not say in so many words that the 600 W and EX-PWR-930-AC supplies are accepted in place of the minimum, so the bays take every supply at or above the minimum and a configuration seats the one shipped.

rear.note: Guide Figure 4, rear seen from behind with x = 0 at the left of the drawing: the fan tray plate 0.6 to 245.6 mm across and 2.7 to 26.9 mm down; below it VCP-0 at 18.9 to 55.1 x 29.6 to 37.9 and VCP-1 at 67.9 to 103.9, the USB port at 121.6 to 136.4, the temperature shutdown lamp centred at (145.3, 35.2), the management jack at 153.7 to 170.0, the console jack at 180.5 to 195.8 and the ESD point centred at (218.0, 36.2); power supply slot 1 from 249.8 and slot 0 from 340.5, each 90.0 mm wide and 41.5 mm high from 2.5 mm down. The figure labels the left supply "Power Supply 1" and the right "Power Supply 0". The small round screws between the ports are named by no callout and are not drawn.

rear-ground.note: The protective earthing terminal is on the SIDE PANEL (Figure 4's callout), a two-hole terminal; no figure gives its position, so the side faces carry an `empty` sentence and it is a gap.

rear-legends.note: Guide Figure 10 draws M, G, M, T stacked upright beside the management jack and VCP-0 and VCP-1 under the Virtual Chassis ports; the legend beside the console jack is too small to read. MGMT is drawn as the word turned to read top to bottom, the VCP legends as printed, and CON as an estimate of the unreadable one.

rear-temperature-lamp.note: Guide, Rear Panel of an EX4200 Switch: "Temperature shutdown LED". No colour is stated.

rear-vcp.note: Two Virtual Chassis ports, "68-pin connector" (guide, Virtual Chassis Ports Connector Pinout Information), joined with the Virtual Chassis cable that ships with the switch. No document names the connector; a part of the family (juniper/ex4200-vcp-port) is drawn from Figure 4's 36.2 x 8.3 mm opening. The guide also lets the SFP network ports of this model be configured as VCPs.

sources.note: EX4200 Switch Hardware Guide, Juniper Networks, published 2022-01-16 (341 pages; PDF created 2022-01-16; Juniper keeps it in its EX Series documentation archive, https://www.juniper.net/documentation/en_US/release-independent/downloads/ex-series/ex-series-doc-archives.zip, member ex-series-doc-archives/ex4200.pdf): Table 1 (models), Table 3 (chassis size and weight), Figure 3 (front panel drawing of the 24-port fibre switch), Figure 4 (rear panel), Figures 5 to 14 (LCD panel, lamps and uplink modules), Figures 15 to 19 (fan tray, airflow and supplies), Tables 4 to 13 (lamps and power), Table 37 (packing list) and the installation procedures. EX4200 Ethernet Switch with Virtual Chassis Technology Datasheet (Juniper Networks, 13 pages, document 1000215-026-EN, Feb 2019; PDF created 2019-02-11, https://www.juniper.net/content/dam/www/assets/datasheets/us/en/switches/ex4200-ethernet-switch-with-vitual-chassis-technology.pdf): Table 1, specifications, per-model weights and noise, ordering information and the product photographs on page 6 (2175 x 811 px; the fibre view is captioned EX4200-24F). Juniper's image-library photographs (www.juniper.net/content/dam/www/assets/images/us/en/image-library/ex-series/<SKU>/<SKU>-front-high.jpg and -rear-high.jpg for each EX4200 model) were requested on 2026-10-23 and every address answered 404, so no studio photograph is held. No EX4200 quick start is in the archive zip. Terms of use: the guide, datasheet and photographs are Juniper's, published for customers; none is copied into the library, only transcribed facts and new drawings. The guide's figures are isometric drawings and the datasheet photographs are perspective views from above, so every position is a measurement of a projection and is estimated.

uplink-slot.note: One front-panel uplink module slot under a flip-up door; the packing list ships a cover panel (the blanking panel) preinstalled, and uplink modules "must be ordered separately". The slot is a bay that takes the cover here. THE MODULES ARE NOT MODELLED, by the task's rule: EX-UM-4SFP (4 SFP ports), EX-UM-2X4SFP (2 SFP+ ports, or 4 SFP in 1-gigabit mode), EX-UM-2X4SFP-M (the same with MACsec) and EX-UM-2XFP (2 XFP ports). The 24F photograph shows the slot with an XFP module fitted.
